# Monarch
> Open-source (MIT) design system for everyone who builds: startups, enterprise teams, independent designers and developers. Design tokens; light, dark and high-contrast themes; accessible brand palettes from one colour (deriveTheme); server-render safe React components including charts, data tables, scheduling, collaboration, an editor and marketing blocks; and a conformance CLI. Made by Rook.

- Start here: README.md, AGENTS.md
- Component API (machine-readable): packages/react/dist/manifest.json (after build) or @rookcom/monarch-react/manifest.json
- Tokens (DTCG JSON): @rookcom/monarch-tokens/tokens.json
- Contrast decisions per product: @rookcom/monarch-tokens/contrast-report.json
- Guides: docs/guides/getting-started.md, theming.md, migration.md, component-contract.md, conformance.md, brand.md
- Governance: docs/governance/versioning.md, deprecation.md, exceptions.md, COMPONENT-GOVERNANCE.md, CONTRIBUTION-GUIDELINES.md, DEPRECATION-POLICY.md
- Component registry (generated, machine-readable): registry/components.json; index of architecture docs: docs/README.md
- Decisions: docs/adr/
- Product brand data: registry/products/*.json
- License: MIT (LICENSE)
